steps.explanation: Register on the relevant counselling portal after results are declared.
List colleges/branches in your true order of preference — order matters more than caution.
An algorithm allots the best possible seat from your list based on rank and seat availability.
Freeze locks your seat; float keeps you eligible for a better one in later rounds; slide keeps you within the same institute for a better branch.
Complete document verification and pay the confirmation fee within the deadline or lose the seat.

key_terms.meaning: Accept and lock the current allotted seat; you exit further rounds.
Stay open to a better college/branch in the next round; risk losing current allotment if you don't respond in time.
Stay in the same institute but remain open to a better branch.
